**Problem**: The `LinearGradient` component from `react-native-linear-gradient` was clipping its child content (the "Watch Now" text and play icon) when used as a direct container.

**Solution**: Restructured the button to use a layered approach:

- `primaryBtnContent`: A `View` containing the text content, positioned on top of the gradient
